sealed.statement: An authenticated CALL BINDING executes each resolved shard's pinned WASM run export on a node hosting the selected active partition replica, including when no ready Binding Cell pre-existed there, and real multi-node evidence proves raw shard rows never leave that node before run while existing Artifact, Cell placement, and runtime lifecycle owners remain authoritative.

constraints.statement: Build on the canonical CALL BINDING ingress, fan-out, dispatch, and reduce path owned by minimal-deployment-call-cell-production-wiring; do not replace or silently widen that predecessor.

Reuse the installable Artifact resolver/cache, RuntimeServiceRebalancerOwner, ServiceRuntimeLifecycle, RuntimeDriverRegistry, ServiceDispatcher, MessageRouter, and runtime invocation owner; introduce no parallel registry, scheduler, transport, or Component lifecycle.
Any execution capacity made available on a selected partition replica node is system policy output, never Binding replica intent or caller-selected placement, and must remain bounded and reclaimable.

Every local activation and invocation remains pinned to the immutable Binding Artifact identity and fails closed or retries through the canonical typed path when artifact identity, partition epoch, replica ownership, or target readiness is stale.

Resolve target partitions and selected replica ownership through the existing PartitionResolver, QueryExecutor routing path, and canonical CDC-fed partition owner and epoch rows; introduce no parallel topology cache, replica selector, or locally re-derived ownership decision.
The selected partition's raw shard rows must not leave its replica node before the pinned Component run export executes; only bounded emitted partials may enter the reduce exchange.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

hypothesis: partition-local run: the invoker plans shards without fetching rows (planShards), resolves each shard's host via the canonical routing snapshot (call-partition-topology, fencing tokens included), dispatches under host-restricted route selection (hostNodeId on the route, HOST_CELL_UNAVAILABLE as the distinct activation trigger), and the receiver builds the typed batch from its OWN partition replica (bounded partitionService.executeQuery + toCellBatch) — two-node evidence proves each shard ran on its partition host with ZERO shard-table deliveries on the router

missing-cell activation: bounded CDC-propagated call_activation_leases system table (5-point registration) published by the invocation owner on HOST_CELL_UNAVAILABLE through the engine internal SQL path; the placement planner consumes LIVE leases as deterministic activation pins (getRuntimeServicePolicy attach + MovePlanner forces pinned available nodes into target, foreign/lapsed pins ignored); the invoker retries bounded and never schedules; two-node evidence: lease -> real-planner pin -> activation on the shard host -> local run with zero shard-row crossings; lapsed lease stops pinning so the surplus cure reclaims

identity and topology fencing: the dispatch carries the CDC-visible fence tokens the topology module resolved (partitionVersion, activePartitionVersion, leader host, state), and the receiver re-asserts them against its own cache rows before anything executes — ownership moved, epoch bumped, non-NORMAL state, or a fence naming another node all refuse typed TARGET_STALE retryable preserveReplicaState invoked=false; artifact identity stays pinned through the existing route digest re-assert; slot-scoped wire identities keep the durable fence per-dispatch

owner-boundary preservation guards: the topology module is a stateless pass-through consulting the canonical routing owner on every resolution; the invoker's public surface is invoke() only (no placement API) and the caller request carries no node input; the lease owner's grammar writes exactly the registered activation lease table with a bounded expiry; placement remains planner output (pins enter only through the policy object); plus the aggregate doneWhen harness binding all four frontier surfaces
